evidence: Isolated: task/task.toml:26-28 '[verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0 / environment_mode = "separate"'; test.sh runs inside the separate verifier image built from task/tests/Dockerfile, which COPYs only the tests context (line 43 'COPY . /tests', line 44 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests'); the agent image task/environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), no tests or solution. Credentialed: task/task.toml:30-35 is exactly REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" - byte-identical to staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71 and to the frozen template; `diff template/task.toml task/task.toml` differs only in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] difficulty/difficulty_explanation/category/provenance/arena_slice (lines 5-7, 10-12, 14-15); lines 17-38 ([agent], [environment], [verifier], [verifier.env], [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public") are identical. No live secret, only the ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template. test.sh:63-66 refuses to grade (writes zero reward) if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset, and test.sh:207 invokes 'rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1 --output ... /tests/$suite' with no model override. Judge files: all five task/tests/*/*/judge.toml have line 2 'judge = "claude-code"' (the expected fallback, matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE); a grep for 'model' across the five judge.toml files and scoring.toml returns nothing; no reasoning effort, temperature or [judge] weight keys either. Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...5fdd) is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile; bases are versioned tags node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (not latest; not digest-pinned, but template-controlled and the shared policy only requires versioned bases); npm globals pinned (@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, lines 16-22); pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31); Chromium is installed by the pinned @playwright/mcp's bundled playwright CLI (lines 33-38), so its version is fixed transitively; apt packages unpinned (line 12-13), which deterministic-checks treats as a NOTE. Network: [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" (task.toml:37-38) and no allowed_hosts - correct per the delivery profile. test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, .dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are all byte-identical to the template (diff reported IDENTICAL). Weak-app / conforming-alternative probes: this row is configuration-only; no submitted app can change [verifier.env], the verifier image or judge.toml, because the agent image contains no /tests and the verifier is a separate environment, so a broken app cannot influence which judge/model grades it; conversely a conforming app cannot be failed by this wiring unless the OpenRouter credential is absent at run time, which test.sh handles by scoring 0 for every app equally (a harness-level outage, not a submission defect). Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the only runs are scripted golden observations in hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair, not a configured judge run. So actual OpenRouter authentication and claude-code launch with glm-5.3-flashx are not exercised here; that measurement belongs to the full-verifier-launch runtime record required by REVIEW_POLICY.md, and this row's verify procedure (quality-checks.md:47-48) is satisfied statically. Note: the Internal Quality Checks annotation still mentions '+ allowlist'; the current public row text and skill override it, so no allowlist is required.
